patterns.name: 4v2 Rondo
patterns.notes:
Setup: 9 m square, four blues on the corners, two reds inside.

Coaching points:
- Receive on the back foot, open body to the next pass.
- Two touches maximum; one if the picture allows.
- Defenders: press together, ball side and cover.

Progression: one touch only. Swap a defender in on every interception.

frames.note: Blue 1 on the ball. Both defenders press the ball side.
Defender 1 arrives late. Pass on before the second defender closes.
Split pass through the middle when the two defenders are flat.

patterns.name: Overlap Down the Wing
patterns.notes:
Attacking pattern for a 4-3-3 or 4-2-3-1.

Triggers: winger receives facing the touchline; full back has space ahead.

Coaching points:
- Winger takes one touch inside to drag the defender.
- Full back's run bends away from the winger so both cannot be marked by one player.
- 9 waits on the shoulder, arrives late at the near post.

frames.note: Winger checks inside, full back overlaps on the outside.
Release the overlap. 9 attacks the near post.
Cut-back or cross. Everyone in the box arrives late.

patterns.name: Pressing Trigger: Pass to Centre Back
patterns.notes:
High press from a 4-3-3 against a team playing out from the back.

The trigger is the goalkeeper's pass to a centre back. Nobody moves before it.

Coaching points:
- 9 presses on a curve so the switch across the back is closed.
- Near winger shows the full back outside, towards the touchline.
- Midfield three step up together; the far side tucks in, not out.
- If the ball goes long, drop and reset.

frames.note: Goalkeeper has the ball. Stay compact and wait for the pass.
Pass to the centre back is the trigger. 9 curves the run to cut off the switch, 11 shows the full back outside.
Ball is forced to the full back on the touchline. Win it here or force the long clearance.

patterns.name: Switch of Play
patterns.notes:
Escape a crowded side in three passes.

Coaching points:
- First pass backwards is fine: it buys the angle.
- Centre backs split wide enough that the second pass moves the block.
- Receiving full back stays high and wide until the ball is in the air.

frames.note: Left side is crowded. Left back plays back to the centre back.
Centre back to centre back. Take the ball across the body, face forward.
Long diagonal to the full back, winger runs off the far side. Three passes, whole pitch switched.

patterns.name: 1v1 to Goal
patterns.notes:
Setup: two cone gates 8 m from the goal. Attacker starts 30 m out; defender starts on the edge of the box.

Attacker: commit the defender, change pace through the gate they leave.
Defender: side on, slow the attacker, force them wide.

Rotate: attacker becomes defender, defender joins the queue.

frames.note: Attacker dribbles at the defender. Defender jockeys, does not dive in.
Attack the gate the defender leaves. Change of pace after the feint.

patterns.name: 4-4-2 Defensive Shape
patterns.notes:
Mid block in a 4-4-2 without the ball.

Coaching points:
- Distance between the lines: 10 m, no more.
- When the ball goes wide, slide as a unit. The far side tucks in and leaves the far winger.
- Strikers stay connected to the midfield, not chasing.

Balls are hidden on this drill: it is about shape, not possession.

frames.note: Ball in the middle. Two lines of four, 10 m apart, strikers screen the centre.
Ball on the near touchline. Whole block slides across, far full back tucks in.
